facts.claim: Tippu had to pay three crores of rupees and cede one half of his dominions to the Company and its allies.
facts.quote: Tippu had to pay th*ee crores of Rupees and to cede one half of his dominions to the Company and to its allies, the Nizam and PeiBhwa, “from the countries adjacent, according to their situation.”

facts.claim: Tippu transferred his claims of allegiance and the tribute of Rs. 24,000 annually from the R&jah to the English and peace was concluded in March 1792.
facts.quote: he transferred his claims of allegi- ance and the tribute of Rs. 24,000 annually from the R&jah to the English and peace was concluded (March 1792).
